Harbor repair plan

Municipal engineers published the complete plan for restoring the east harbor after the storm.

The city will begin structural repairs on Monday and maintain a pedestrian route beside the closed pier.

Crews will publish progress notices each morning, and ferry schedules will remain available from the harbor office.

A separate flood response story

Emergency teams opened a separate flood response center across town and announced a different schedule for residents.

The independent report describes shelter locations, road closures, and its own public contact information.

Reader comments

Reader comment: the harbor office confirmed that the temporary route is accessible from the north entrance.
